qa_verdict_scope: QA criteria and published-source accuracy for an oral-PrEP educational carousel; not a certification of current 2026 Manado facility SOP and not a physician or owner release approval
release_caveats: 2023 Indonesian oral-PrEP Juknis says month-1 follow-up visit also exists; three-month HIV testing is not a claim that all visits are at month 3.
2026 Permenkes 3/2026 is in force; do not represent the published 2023 Juknis as a certified current 2026 local clinic SOP without new evidence.
US CDC 2026 baseline renal assessment rules differ from Indonesia's published 2023 guideline; do not blend US and Indonesia jurisdictional instructions.
Any current Manado clinic-specific schedule, availability, clinician-patient suitability or testing algorithm requires the facility or clinician to verify; neither slide nor caption promises these.
Medical sensitive-claim flag YES requires explicit authorized human signoff at STG-09; owner has accepted visual preview only.
